acceptance_predicates.description: All shell styling uses semantic state tokens with non-color focus/selection distinctions.
Wizard routes render a coherent header, content frame, step region, and contextual footer across supported sizes.
Descriptions, labels, warnings, and empty states follow bounded wrapping and hierarchy rules.
Shell elements are represented in the formal model, UI ownership inventory, and contextual-help catalog.

definition_of_done: The TUI has one tested visual language and responsive shell rather than route-local ad hoc styling.

outputs.description: Semantic styles, persistent shell layout, and visual regression fixtures.

gates.description: Renderer and PTY fixtures cover normal, narrow, monochrome, warning, and error shell states.
